scripts.generate: redocly bundle openapi/platform.v1.yaml --output generated/platform.v1.openapi.json --ext json && openapi-typescript openapi/platform.v1.yaml -o generated/platform.v1.d.ts && redocly bundle openapi/ocpp-gateway.internal.v1.yaml --output generated/ocpp-gateway.internal.v1.openapi.json --ext json && openapi-typescript openapi/ocpp-gateway.internal.v1.yaml -o generated/ocpp-gateway.internal.v1.d.ts && node scripts/copy-event-schema.mjs
